whatsNew:
Creating an account, and signing in

Both screens were rebuilt. Same fields, same security, but they fit on one screen now — no scrolling to sign up, and the same look as the rest of the app.

Conversation controls

Opening the controls for a chat or a group used to mean a long list and a lot of scrolling. Everything is on one screen now: the things you change most sit at the top, the rest are single rows that open only when you want them.

Please check

- Create a new account without scrolling, then sign out and sign back in.
- Open the controls on a one-to-one chat and on a group. Change the notification and translation settings; they save on their own.
- Add someone to a group, and leave a group.

Notifications for a message you have already read are held back, but only after five seconds — tell me if one still arrives for a chat you are looking at.
